title: Croatian Stew in Yellow Broth
description: A hearty Chinese-inspired stew featuring tender Croatian sausage and soft onions, all swimming in a rich yellow broth.
instructions: Heat the stew in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Croatian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced yellow onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the silky soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
